title: Delaware BEAD operation hold: 4,728 planned connections await construction
summary: Delaware reports federal approval for a plan covering more than 4,728 homes and businesses, with $27.8 million in federal infrastructure funds and construction expected to begin in fall 2026. Denominator: The approved Delaware plan's 4,728-location buildout across New Castle, Kent, and Sussex counties.
